item.title: Gun owners have until March 31 to express interest in gun compensation
item.description: OTTAWA — The period for gun owners to declare interest in a federal program offering compensation for turning in or permanently deactivating their guns began Monday.

item.title: Air Transat to create new loyalty program with Desjardins and Visa
item.description: Air Transat has announced plans to start a new loyalty program with Desjardins Group and Visa. The launch, planned for the second half of this year, will offer travellers exclusive benefits and an improved experience, the airline said.

item.title: Duclair scores two, Islanders extend Canucks' winless skid to 11 games
item.description: VANCOUVER — Anthony Duclair scored twice and the New York Islanders downed the troubled Vancouver Canucks 4-3 on Monday.

item.title: Analysis: China's birth-rate struggles underscore its millennia-long struggle to manage 'the masses'
item.description: BEIJING (AP) — From ancient times until today, an enormous population has been a foundational way for China to project its strength. But anxiety about managing so many mouths has always loomed.

item.title: Defending champ Madison Keys advances to 2nd round at Australian Open
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Defending champion Madison Keys struggled early but held on to defeat Oleksandra Oliynykova and her offbeat style of game 7-6 (6), 6-1 in a first-round match Tuesday at the Australian Open.

item.title: Valentino, designer whose gowns made royals and movie stars feel beautiful, dies at 93
item.description: MILAN (AP) — Valentino Garavani, the jet-set Italian designer whose high-glamour gowns — often in his trademark shade of “Valentino red” — were fashion show staples for nearly half a century, died Monday. He was 93.

item.title: Brandon Bussi makes 17 saves as the Hurricanes beat the Sabres 2-1
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (AP) — Brandon Bussi made 17 saves for his 18th win of the season, Seth Jarvis scored the go-ahead goal on a power play early in the third period and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Buffalo Sabres 2-1 on Monday.
